days6To15.title: UK Outlook for Tuesday 24 Nov 2026 to Thursday 3 Dec 2026
days6To15.text: Bands of rain will move in from the Atlantic at times, making erratic and uncertain eastward progress across the UK. These systems may also bring occasional strong winds. Either side of bands of rain a mixture of clear/sunny spells and showers. Often rather cold in northern areas which could allow precipitation to fall as snow at times, mainly over hills. Generally milder in the south though still potential for some cold nights in clearer spells. Through late November, there is an increasing chance that high pressure will start to have more influence bringing more settled conditions, particularly across the north. Temperatures likely staying close to average, although an ingress of colder conditions cannot be ruled out.

days16To30.title: UK Outlook for Friday 4 Dec 2026 to Friday 18 Dec 2026
days16To30.text: The track of low pressure systems will likely be further south than normal during this period. Temperatures in the south will probably be near normal or perhaps slightly above at times, with the north colder than normal, although either bias could extended to cover a wider area of the UK at times.

sections.text: Heavy, blustery showers continue tonight with a risk of thunder and hail at times. Winds will remain strong towards southwestern coasts and near showers, but becoming lighter elsewhere. A milder night than Wednesday night for most.

sections.title: Friday:
sections.text: On Friday, showers dissipate, with sunny intervals developing away from lingering low cloud in the east. Winds ease and daytime temperatures are near average, but cold overnight with patchy frost.

sections.title: Outlook for Saturday to Monday:
